segments.name: CHEERS App Internet Business
segments.description: Runs the CHEERS App, earning advertising from short videos, live streams and in-app ads, plus service fees from its Cheers E-mall marketplace.
segments.evidence: Our CHEERS App Internet Business generates advertising revenue from broadcasting IP short videos, live streaming and APP advertising through our CHEERS App and service revenue from our Cheers E-mall marketplace.

segments.name: Traditional Media Business
segments.description: Earns mainly advertising revenue from Cheers TV-series, plus copyright revenue and customized content production revenue.
segments.evidence: Our Traditional Media Business mainly contributes to the advertising revenue from our Cheers TV-series, copyright revenue, customized content production revenue and others.

revenueModel.text: Advertising customers pay for ads on its apps and video content; copyright licensing and CHEERS e-Mall market services bring in the rest.
revenueModel.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, we primarily generated revenues from three revenue streams: advertising, copyright licensing, and CHEERS e-Mall market service.
